title: TriSearch: Learning to Optimize Triangulations via Bistellar Flips
abstract: arXiv:2605.30220v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We introduce TriSearch, a reinforcement learning framework for optimizing objectives over triangulations of a polytope via bistellar flips. The key idea is a circuit-supported subtriangulation action representation: feasible flips are encoded by their supporting circuit and realized local subtriangulation, enabling a learned policy to rank them using local geometric and combinatorial features. This yields a dimension-agnostic interface and enables efficient traversal of the flip graph without explicit enumeration of the full triangulation space. Instantiated in 3D and 4D, TriSearch generalizes zero-shot from small training instances to larger polytopes with exponentially larger search spaces. It achieves top performance on metric objectives in 3D and, in 4D, discovers more distinct Fine, Regular, Star triangulations of reflexive polytopes, corresponding to Calabi-Yau threefolds, than existing samplers under a fixed budget.

translated_title: TriSearch：通过双星翻转学习优化三角剖分
translated_abstract: 我们提出了TriSearch，一个通过双星翻转来优化多胞体三角剖分目标的强化学习框架。其核心思想是一种基于电路支持的子三角剖分动作表示：可行的翻转通过其支撑电路和所实现的局部子三角剖分进行编码，使学习到的策略能够利用局部几何和组合特征对这些翻转进行排序。这产生了一个与维度无关的接口，并能够在不显式枚举完整三角剖分空间的情况下高效遍历翻转图。在3维和4维中实例化后，TriSearch能够从小型训练实例零样本泛化到搜索空间呈指数级增大的更大多胞体。它在3维的度量目标上取得了顶尖性能；在4维中，在固定预算下，它发现了比现有采样器更多的反射多胞体上互不相同的精细、正则、星三角剖分，这些三角剖分对应于Calabi-Yau三维流形。
tldr: TriSearch是一个基于强化学习的三角剖分优化框架，其核心创新是电路支持的子三角剖分动作表示，实现了与维度无关的翻转图高效遍历，可零样本泛化到搜索空间指数级增大的更大多胞体，并在4维中发现了更多对应Calabi-Yau三维流形的三角剖分。
en_tdlr: TriSearch is a reinforcement learning framework that optimizes polytope triangulations via bistellar flips, whose key innovation—a circuit-supported subtriangulation action representation—enables dimension-agnostic, efficient flip graph traversal, zero-shot generalization to polytopes with exponentially larger search spaces, and the discovery of more Calabi-Yau threefold triangulations in 4D.
